description: NaMg₁₄LaO₁₆ is Caswellsilverite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.33 Å. There are eight inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.21 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.21 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.41 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.25 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.32 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.22 Å. In the seventh Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.32 Å. In the eighth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-8°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.33 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.36 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one La atom to form OLaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six OLaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six OLaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six OLaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. There are two shorter (2.09 Å) and two longer (2.21 Å) O-Mg bond lengths. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-11°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent La atoms to form OLa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OLa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OLa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OLa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, four Mg, and one La atom to form ONaLaMg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONaLaMg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, four Mg, and one La atom to form ONaLaMg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONaLaMg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are two shorter (2.20 Å) and two longer (2.24 Å) O-Mg bond lengths. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONaLaMg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OLaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°.
